FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o /out/ms-go-statistic ./cmd/ms-go-statistic
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o /out/ms-go-statistic-migrate ./cmd/migrate

FROM alpine:3.20
RUN adduser -D appuser
USER appuser
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /out/ms-go-statistic /app/ms-go-statistic
COPY --from=builder /out/ms-go-statistic-migrate /app/ms-go-statistic-migrate
COPY migrations /app/migrations
ENV STAT_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/ms-go-statistic"]
